title: My Fiancé’s Secret Wife Was Living in My House
description: Evelyn spent eight years and millions of dollars building her fiancé’s empire, only to discover a week before their wedding that he’s already legally married. Refusing to play the victim, she teams up with his fiercest corporate rival to expose his lies, reclaim her stolen wealth, and ruin him publicly. This is the ultimate story of betrayal, power, and sweet revenge you won't be able to turn off.
